changes: Declared WebGL image-edge convention adds 0.5 to raster index-centre coordinates.
Sphere centre/range are fitted jointly from the unit-ray tangent cone, including off-axis perspective.
Both masks use half-pixel binary boundary crossings; foreground contour centres shrink the naive radius.
reconstruction_revision.interpretation: SAM depth does not improve on this clip; its small mean regression is preserved. Centroid error changes through coordinate registration, not improved segmentation. No correction was fitted to evaluator truth.

limitations: One deterministic synthetic video, not real-world generalization.
Original report and script are preserved; +0.5 px registration follows declared WebGL convention, not truth fitting.
HSV baseline is specialized to an orange ball; SAM is prompted by concept.
Largest-contour baseline resets its identity after a missing frame; ID statistics must be read with that declared policy.
3D uses the same declared camera/diameter reconstruction for both; reported errors include silhouette/depth estimation.
Missing detections are counted explicitly and never assigned zero error.
